name: Patron
author: Kirin
short: Supporter roles and currency from Patreon and Buy Me a Coffee
description: Polls the Patreon API and receives Buy Me a Coffee webhooks to manage supporter roles and pay monthly currency rewards through Unicornia. Requires the 'Unicornia' cog for economy features.
install_msg: Thanks for installing the Patron cog! Run `[p]patronset creds` for the API credentials and webhook setup, then `[p]help patronset`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores supporters' Patreon and Buy Me a Coffee names, email addresses, pledge amounts and payment progress, and the Discord IDs they are linked to. Rewards are recorded in Unicornia. Red data-deletion requests remove these records.
